I posted the answer in #central-team as a reply to Pree. I couldn't find a site for the store.

The June 9 thread in #central-team names the store as Pine Crossing, and the afternoon-only appointment screen is from that thread. The onboarding ticket SUP-5102 lists six new stores and doesn't include Pine Crossing. Its closest name is Mill Crossing, which I flagged as unconfirmed. The store address sheet the ticket refers to isn't in any file I can see, so I couldn't check the site. I suggested she confirm with Hollis or the store-ops contact before updating the account sheet.
